verses.1: The man who did not go along with the counsel of the wicked, nor followed in the path of sin, and who did not sit on the throne of evilness.
verses.2: For if it is in the will of Jehovah, then he will act according to His will, day and night.
verses.3: And it shall be like a tree that grows on the shores of the sea. Its fruit will be given to those who ask for it. And nothing that is done will fail.
verses.4: It is not the wicked who are punished, but rather those whose souls have been driven away.
verses.5: Therefore, the wicked will not stand before judgment, and their sins will not be forgiven by the righteous.
verses.6: For Jehovah knows the ways of the righteous and the ways of the wicked.
